Registration information

  • Please ensure you read the Terms & Conditions and Cancellations & Withdrawal Policy before registering.
  • Prices are in USD and include 18% GST + processing fees.
  • Athletes must be 18 years of age on race day.
  • Only one entry per email address is accepted. Please ensure you have access to a unique email address to process your registration.
  • This event offers slots to the IRONMAN 70.3 World Championship. 

Online registrations are synced to our database within 24 hours. You will automatically receive a registration confirmation e-mail from our registration partner.  
 
Your age group category for the event you registered for will be reflective of your age as of 31 December of the event year. 

You can sign in to your IRONMAN profile to check your registration status at any time, below: 
My IRONMAN profile >> 

Your name, and the names of other starters will be searchable on the IRONMAN Tracker App the day prior to your race. 

Upon registration, the team captain will be asked to create a team, providing a team name and add at minimum 1 team member to claim the entry. 

The team members that are sent a “Claim” from the relay captain at the time of registration can register through the Claim email. 

To add team members after this, the team captain can email the event email address, and the new team member will be sent an email to register to the team at checkout, the captain will be required to pay the full registration fee. 

During the registration process, team members might need to purchase a one day license depending on the federation requirements of the country the race takes place.

  • 2026 IRONMAN 70.3 Goa is an age group-only event, please read the IRONMAN Pro Athletes page to understand eligibility requirements when competing in age group races.
  • Athletes are responsible for understanding their membership status with their national Federation and must register with the correct status.
  • For anyone registered with the Indian Triathlon Federation, refer here for your Membership & National Ranking status.
  • For further information or clarification please email [email protected]

All registrations are non-refundable after the specified cancellation dates. Registrations are non-transferable.

Athletes confirmed in the race who wish to withdraw, must do so in writing to the race office via email at [email protected]

Refund policy for new athletes who registered in the 2026 IRONMAN 70.3 Goa:

  • Any requests received before 11:59pm (IST) on 1 July 2026 will be eligible for a 50% refund of the event entry fee paid.
  • Any requests received before 11:59pm (IST) on 17 September 2026 will be eligible for a 25% refund of the event entry fee paid.
  • Any requests received after 11:59pm (IST) on 17 September 2026 will not be eligible for a refund under any circumstances.

Relay Team Changes Request:

  • Any request for change in team members will be accepted only once.
  • Any additional requests would be charged at USD 100 per change.
  • No changes will be accepted after 11:59pm (IST) on 17 September 2026 and this is applicable both for the first change request or any subsequent ones.
  • No personalizations for athlete items such as name on Bib, T-Shirt size can be assured if any changes are requested after 7 October 2026

Package registration is non-refundable and non-transferable.

Any additional purchases including but not limited to; Registration Fees paid at the time of entry are non-refundable at any time.
